Selective small-molecule inhibitor of the KRAS G12C mutant protein that irreversibly binds and locks it in its inactive state, thereby blocking oncogenic RAS signaling in cancer cells.
ACE inhibitor shown in ISIS-4 to reduce mortality when given early after acute myocardial infarction.
Block leukotriene chemicals that cause airway inflammation and bronchoconstriction in asthma. Used as add-on or alternative therapy, particularly in allergic asthma.
Angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors that lower blood pressure and reduce cardiac workload. Used in heart failure, hypertension, and kidney protection in diabetic patients.
Anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody checkpoint inhibitor used in combination with ipilimumab for advanced melanoma.
An antifungal medication used to treat serious infections caused by specific types of fungi, such as Candida and Cryptococcus.
Tezacaftor is a CFTR corrector drug that improves the folding and trafficking of defective CFTR protein to the cell surface, helping restore chloride transport in patients with cystic fibrosis.
Class IC antiarrhythmic drug that suppresses ventricular ectopy but was found to increase mortality in post-MI patients in the CAST trial.
Lipid-lowering medications that reduce LDL cholesterol by inhibiting HMG-CoA reductase. Cornerstone therapy for prevention of ischemic heart disease and cardiovascular events.
Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) prescribed for depression, anxiety disorders, PTSD, and OCD. Marketed as Zoloft.
GLP-1 receptor agonist used to treat type 2 diabetes and obesity. Marketed as Ozempic and Wegovy, it reduces appetite and improves glycemic control.

nodes.text: Methotrexate belongs to the group of medicines known as antineoplastics (cancer medicines). It blocks an enzyme that is needed by cells to live. This interferes with the growth of cancer cells, which are eventually destroyed by the body.
Biguanide oral antidiabetic agent that reduces hepatic glucose production and improves insulin sensitivity, used as first-line therapy in type 2 diabetes.
First-line oral medication for type 2 diabetes that lowers blood glucose by reducing hepatic glucose production and improving insulin sensitivity. Increasingly studied for longevity benefits.
Ipatasertib is an oral small-molecule inhibitor of AKT that blocks PI3K/AKT pathway signaling, thereby reducing cancer cell proliferation and survival in tumors with pathway activation.
Peptide hormone replacement used to control blood glucose in diabetes and used in intensive glucose-control trial arms.

Antibiotic that inhibits bacterial folate (folic acid) synthesis, which is essential for DNA production. Trimethoprim works by inhibiting the bacterial enzyme dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR), blocking the conversion of dihydrofolate to tetrahydrofolate. This prevents bacteria from synthesizing DNA, RNA, and proteins, thereby stopping their growth.
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor that lowers LDL cholesterol by reducing hepatic cholesterol synthesis, thereby decreasing the risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
Capivasertib is an oral AKT kinase inhibitor that blocks the PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway, reducing tumor cell growth and survival in cancers with pathway activation.
Treatments that reduce or block hormone levels that fuel certain cancers. Used in breast cancer (estrogen) and prostate cancer (testosterone) to slow or stop tumor growth.

Medications that increase urine output to reduce fluid overload in the body. Essential in heart failure management to relieve edema and pulmonary congestion.
Medications that relax bronchial smooth muscle to widen the airways and improve airflow. First-line treatment for COPD and acute asthma episodes.
Anti-inflammatory steroids delivered directly into the lungs to reduce airway inflammation. Core maintenance therapy for persistent asthma and moderate-to-severe COPD.
Class of broad-spectrum antibiotics that inhibit bacterial protein synthesis. They are effective against many Gram-positive bacteria, Gram-negative bacteria, and some intracellular pathogens
Tissue plasminogen activator (alteplase) that dissolves blood clots in acute ischemic stroke. Must be administered within 4.5 hours of symptom onset for maximum benefit.
Medications that block beta-adrenergic receptors, reducing heart rate and blood pressure. Used in heart failure, hypertension, arrhythmia, and post-heart attack management.
Angiotensin receptor blockers that prevent angiotensin II from constricting blood vessels. Used as an alternative to ACE inhibitors in heart failure and hypertension treatment.
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor, most potent statin on a mg-for-mg basis

nodes.text: Lumacaftor is a CFTR corrector that improves the folding and trafficking of the F508del-mutated CFTR protein to the cell surface, helping restore chloride transport in cystic fibrosis.
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin) that lowers blood cholesterol levels by blocking the rate-limiting step in hepatic cholesterol synthesis, thereby reducing cardiovascular risk.
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor reducing LDL cholesterol and cardiovascular risk in patients with hypercholesterolemia and coronary disease.
Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to reduce pain, fever, and inflammation. Available over-the-counter for headaches, muscle aches, and arthritis.
Drugs that prevent platelets from aggregating to form clots. Used in stroke prevention and management after cardiac events to reduce recurrence risk.
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug with antiplatelet properties that prevents blood clot formation. Widely used in cardiovascular disease management and secondary prevention.
Ivacaftor is a CFTR potentiator that enhances the gating activity of the CFTR chloride channel at the cell surface, increasing chloride transport in patients with cystic fibrosis.
HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin) that lowers LDL cholesterol and reduces cardiovascular disease risk. One of the most prescribed medications worldwide.
Broad-spectrum penicillin-type antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections including ear infections, pneumonia, urinary tract infections, and strep throat.
Anti-CTLA-4 monoclonal antibody checkpoint inhibitor used in combination with nivolumab for advanced melanoma.
ACE inhibitor used to treat high blood pressure, heart failure, and to improve survival after heart attacks. Works by relaxing blood vessels.
Dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist used for type 2 diabetes and obesity. Marketed as Mounjaro and Zepbound, it has shown significant weight loss and glycemic improvements.
